notes: Discovery + sizing focused on dedicated GPU pools for fraud-scoring ensembles. Short bullets: steady-state target 120 qps (queries/sec) for decisioning service; peak bursts up to 450 qps for promotional windows (durations 3-7 minutes). Avg token footprint ~120 tokens/req (40 prompt, 80 gen) → steady token/sec ≈ 14,400 tok/s, peak ≈ 54,000 tok/s. Latency SLO: p95 <= 120ms for short scoring paths; p99 <= 300ms for full multi-model pipeline. Must support KV caching pinned to customer-managed KMS, and audit logs retained 12 months. Cost target: reduce current $/1k tokens by 30% vs cloud baseline. Preference: multi-model routing (large model for high-confidence cases, quantized medium model for fallback), auto-batching to maintain latency SLO, and cross-region failover. Quote from Head of Platform: "we need deterministic cost + no surprises during seasonality spikes". AE notes: schedule dedicated sizing workshop to capture QPS distributions and finalize reserved GPU count and SLA terms.
